study: S2-R8 adaptive neural representation and continual S2 learning
target: mean absolute actual S1 residual over three internal-state projections, forecast before actual native operation

arms.A: fixed 32, same adaptive readout fitter, no structural change
arms.B: reuse plus native growth and private leaf refinement
arms.C: B with inherited S1 feature ancestry excluded from candidate S2 readouts and product parents; rejected interventions remain rejected
arms.D: B with Fit residuals permuted only for structural proposal direction/ranking; original labels retained for fitting and Check

fixed_32_control_scope: Controls growth and adjustment with the same conditioned fitter. It is not byte-identical to the historical R2 optimizer; historical implementation remains available for replay.
matched_control_scope: D matches input corpus, resource ceiling, candidate generation classes and lesson budgets. Realized recruited topology and measured cost may differ and must be reported; no claim of exact realized-complexity matching.
historical_retention_admission: Two separate 32-case banks from authentic R2 train-0-fit and train-1-fit; retention-only; never put in Fit or final holdout.

final_holdout.selected_checkpoint: fourth block regardless of monitor score

compute_comparison.selection: largest completed training prefix whose cumulative measured learner process CPU cost stays within budget
compute_comparison.scope: replayable prefix comparison, not a preemptive wall-clock controller; acquisition, oracle, checkpoint and replay costs reported separately

primary_metric: pooled RMSE, equally sized conditions and all six seeds

uncertainty.resampling: paired seeds, then complete streams within condition
uncertainty.scope: conditional on this single authenticated lineage and supplied task distributions

Gate_A: All learned parameters in native signed N synapses; one owner per experimental runtime; no second inference system.
Gate_B: Observed causal input distinctions survive codec and at least the selected native readout representation; hidden-outcome twins reported separately as unobserved-information limits.
Gate_C: Positive independent-coordinate control grows beyond 32 with exact replay; solved-function control does not grow; real recruitment admitted only after Check and unchanged retention rules.
Gate_D: B pooled RMSE at least 5 percent better than A and paired CI95 lower bound above zero; no condition RMSE worsens over A by more than 5 percent. Intervals crossing zero are INCONCLUSIVE, clearly adverse results FAIL.
Gate_E: B better than D with causal-control interval excluding zero; selective reuse intervention effective and retention-qualified; read-only new/old ablations reported without treating coadapted inference lesions as the whole learning benefit.
Gate_F: After every block: A-E1 oracle max delta <=1e-7 under revision/time matched evaluation control, C correct 6/6, E1 correct >=35/36; S1 prediction max delta <=1e-7; historical S2 RMSE <=1.05 times matched control +1e-7. All seeds and every failure retained.
Gate_G: Exact checkpoint restart, full authentic-prefix suffix replay, signed reconstruction, source rollback, continued learning after restart and replay of that continuation; lost-ack recovery test.
Gate_H: Measure growth, neurons, synapses, changed weights, learner CPU/wall, inference, process memory and persistence costs; native Go suites and Android arm64 cross-builds. Physical Android latency is outside available equipment.
status_rule: PASS only if all gates demonstrated. PARTIAL if native functionality demonstrated but any required scientific gate fails/remains inconclusive. FAIL if proposed mechanism cannot perform its local objective. INCONCLUSIVE for invalid source or incomplete evidentiary basis.
safety_scope: Isolated research source copies and branch; no main changes, no production checkpoint promotion, no PR, no merge; no seed or checkpoint selection by score.
